svg.title: CQRS — a write on one replica reaches the read models of every replica (and of other services)

g.text: CQRS — a write on one replica reaches the read models of every replica (and of other services)
reject → retry 3x with back-off → DLQ maintenance-3.maintenance.dlq
Aircraft status, set by B3b during the command
A replica that is down keeps receiving into its durable queue and applies the events when it comes back.
Consistency: strong on the owner (same transaction), eventual on the others (normally milliseconds).
